conclusion: Owner-free research continued without future-data blocking. RR1_B20_S4 failed both fresh seeds on maximum regret and was rejected. AT1_A18_B02 passed the first fresh seed but failed replication by the frozen maximum-regret rule and was rejected. CR1_E05, a 5% uniform-contamination mixture on top of R0_T2, passed both seeds of a fresh tail/contamination battery and then both seeds of a separately preregistered balanced clean-plus-shift battery. CR1 is therefore the current synthetic robustness lead only. It is not real validated, not promoted, and cannot be substituted into the frozen R0_T2 prospective assignment. A role-separated independent governance review is required before proposing a separate CR1 real-world test design.
